nodes.n: Jaipur. A lake palace. Nine hundred guests, four drone cameras and a twelve-tier cake that Nikhil calls "content".

nodes.t: Captain, I'm your vice-captain, your best man and the only person here who knows this is fake. I'd like a raise.
Also your Dadi just arrived from Amritsar. Uninvited. With pickle.
Puttar! You marry a film star and you tell me on Instagram? On INSTAGRAM?
Where is she? I want to see if she can make a roti.

choice.t: "Dadi, she's a superstar. She doesn't make rotis."
"Ask her yourself. She's braver than me."

nodes.n: The varmala. Forty thousand flashes. Tara smiles at the cameras like she was born doing it. Maybe she was.

nodes.t: Smile. Lean in. Don't step on my lehenga, it costs more than your bat sponsorship.

nodes.n: The photographer shouts. "A kiss! For the fans!"
For the cameras. Only for the cameras. She forgets to pull away for one second too long. So do you.

nodes.t: She can't make a roti. But she asked me to teach her. Good girl. I like her.

nodes.n: Midnight. The music stops. A man walks in through the garden gate, uninvited, in a white sherwani, carrying a single red rose.

nodes.t: Tara. You forgot to invite your ex-fiancé. I forgive you.

nodes.cliff: Vivaan Rai, the actor who broke Tara's heart on live TV, just crashed your fake wedding.
